<div class="card-body">
'''Old Ben''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ベン翁</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">君のキャラクターのどれか（除くオビ＝ワン）がタトゥイーン位置カードから没収された際、１フォース消費すれば、謎の“狂える魔術師”が立ち寄って復活させてくれる。フォースを消費せずに、同じ場所に再配備すること。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-100o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「あの老いぼれは、気のふれた魔術師にすぎぬ」オビ＝ワンは何年もの間、タトゥイーンの砂漠で生活していた……来るべき時のために。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Old Ben.

'''Card text:''' When one of your characters (except Obi-Wan) is forfeited from a Tatooine site, use 1 Force and a mysterious “crazy wizard” steps in and revives that character. Re-deploy to the same site without using Force.

'''Lore:''' “That old man's just a crazy wizard.” Obi-Wan lived in Tatooine's deserts for years… ready for the right moment.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Old Ben]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
